think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s domain and documented valid range. 2) Check whether any numeric value (commonly 0 or -1) is documented to switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable a feature, auto-tune, unlimited) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) If such a mode-switching value exists, classify as a special knob and record that value; otherwise classify as not special.
